impact: Higher oil and a 5% 10-year add to December hike pressure, a headwind for rate-sensitive growth holdings like NBIS, BE, PLTR and HOOD; a renewed Hormuz premium also lifts energy names.
summary: Trump posted on Truth Social that the US no longer needs a deal with Iran, saying 'those days have long since passed' and that the US holds the Strait. Brent rose about 1.4% to above $94 and WTI about 1.3% to around $87.60, erasing earlier losses. The 10-year Treasury yield rose to about 5.02% as cash bonds reopened after Veterans Day, touching 5.058%, its highest since Oct 22. Weekly jobless claims rose 9,000 to 200,000, above the 195,000 expected.
title: Trump says US doesn't need Iran deal; Brent above $94, 10-year tops 5%
